doc.title: Receiving and Put-Away
doc.purpose: Receive materials safely, check them against the order, and keep them in quarantine until Quality releases them.

roles.name: Receiving Clerk
roles.does: Checks the delivery against the purchase order.

roles.name: Warehouse Supervisor
roles.does: Assigns dock doors and resolves shortages.

roles.name: Purchasing
roles.does: Is told of any delivery more than 2 hours late, or short.

roles.name: Production Planner
roles.does: Is told of any delivery more than 2 hours late, or short.

references.as_written: QP-308 Incoming Inspection of Packaging Materials

parameters.applies_to: forklifts on the dock and in the receiving lanes
parameters.quote: Drive at walking pace on the dock and in the receiving lanes: no faster than 3 mph.
A delivery more than 2 hours late, or short, is reported to Purchasing and to the Production Planner the same shift.

rules.statement: On the dock and in the receiving lanes forklifts drive no faster than 3 mph.
Packaging materials stay in the quarantine lane until the QA Technician releases them.
rules.quote: until the QA Technician releases them (see QP-308).

rules.topic: who checks the dock before entering a trailer
rules.statement: The Forklift Driver chocks the trailer wheels and locks the dock leveler before entering.
rules.quote: Chock the trailer wheels and lock the dock leveler before entering.

unsure.what: Dock doors 1 to 4 have no equipment tag in this document
unsure.why: SP-405 calls the dock levelers DOCK-1 to DOCK-4, but WH-601 does not give tags, so no tag assumed
